Qasam hai Fajr ki
Aur das raaton ki
Aur juft o taaq ki
Aur raat ki jab woh jaane lage
Beshak in cheezon mein qasam hai saahib-e-aql ke liye
Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke tumhaare Rab ne qaum-e-Aad ke saath kya kiya hai
Sutoon waale Iram waale
Jis ka misl doosre shehron mein nahin paida hua hai
Aur Samood ke saath jo waadi mein patthar taraash kar makaan banaate the
Aur meikhon waale Fir'aun ke saath
Jin logon ne shehron mein sarkashi phailaayi
Aur khoob fasaad kiya
To phir Khuda ne un par azaab ke kode barsa diye
Beshak tumhaara Parwardigar zaalimon ki taak mein hai
Lekin insaan ka haal yeh hai ke jab Khuda ne us ko is tarah aazmaaya ke izzat aur ne'mat de di to kehne laga ke mere Rab ne mujhe ba-izzat banaaya hai
Aur jab aazmaaish ke liye rozi ko tang kar diya to kehne laga ke mere Parwardigar ne meri tauheen ki hai
Aisa hargiz nahin hai, balke tum yateemon ka ehteraam nahin karte ho
Aur logon ko miskeenon ke khaane par aamaada nahin karte ho
Aur meeraas ke maal ko ikattha kar ke halaal o haraam sab kha jaate ho
Aur maal-e-duniya ko bahut dost rakhte ho
Yaad rakho ke jab zameen ko reza reza kar diya jaaega
Aur tumhaare Parwardigar ka hukm aur farishte saf dar saf aa jaayenge
Aur Jahannam ko us din saamne laaya jaaega to insaan ko hosh aa jaaega, lekin us din hosh aane ka kya faaida
Insaan kahega ke kaash main ne apni is zindagi ke liye kuch pehle bhej diya hota
To us din Khuda waisa azaab karega jo kisi ne na kiya hoga
Aur na is tarah kisi ne giraftaar kiya hoga
Aye nafs-e-mutma'in
Apne Rab ki taraf palat aa is aalam mein ke tu us se raazi hai aur woh tujh se raazi hai
Phir mere bandon mein shaamil ho ja
Aur meri Jannat mein daakhil ho ja
